description: Find the cheapest available GPU at or below a maximum hourly rate per GPU and prepare a launch plan for it. Use when price is the binding constraint and the user has not picked a specific host. Called without a plan_id it searches (read-only, free) and prepares a plan whose quote is checked against the budget — a quote above it is withdrawn, not offered. Nothing is allocated or billed until the user approves the plan and you call again with confirm:true and that plan_id; the approved plan launches exactly the GPU and price it names, and repeating that call returns the same job.

confirm.description: Intent to launch. Launching also needs plan_id, approved by the user

max_hourly_cad.description: The most to pay per GPU per hour

plan_id.description: The plan a call without it prepared for the cheapest match. Executes only once approved

name: schedule_under_budget
title: Schedule a job under budget
